items.title: Short news: Week 45
items.summary: Catch up with more Counter-Strike news in bite-sized pieces.

items.title: Cobblestone overhaul and Major stickers arrive in new CS update
items.summary: The sticker system has been changed and Cobblestone completely reworked.

items.title: Bad News Eagles relaunch with academy project
items.summary: The famous Albanian-Kosovar tag is back as a proper esports organization.

items.title: cmtry out of Astralis after one month
items.summary: FUT only had a three-week loan deal with Astralis.

items.title: 100 Thieves and fnatic qualify for PGL Cluj-Napoca 2027
items.summary: The team list is now finalized for the $1,000,000 event.

items.title: Stake announces six Ranked events with open qualifiers and $150,000 prize pool for 2027
items.summary: The tournament will return to Belgrade with a new format and 12 teams fighting over an upgraded prize pool across six days.

items.title: BC.Game, TYLOO headline ZOWIE eXTREMESLAND Asia Open team list
items.summary: The $150,000 LAN is set to feature the best regional squads.

items.title: IEM Beijing to return for 2027 and 2028
items.summary: The Chinese capital will feature on the calendar for two more years.

items.title: Cast your vote for the Major MVP medal design
items.summary: The community has the chance to influence a piece of Counter-Strike history once again, thanks to HLTV and 1xBET.

items.title: Community Awards: Vox Populi nominations open
items.summary: We are listening to the voice of the people:  nominate your favorites   until November 22nd.
